original_requirement: Repair the Fresh Short Canary validate-only import closure without approving an unrelated dependency, monkeypatching validation, swallowing import failure, changing production behavior, executing a Provider call, or materializing the Fresh packet.
closed_world_justification: The Canary control plane has two identified standalone real-probe entrypoints and one generic launcher scope. Each probe has a stable explicit profile identity, while all other current launcher paths use the generic scope. New profiles fail closed until explicitly defined and tested.
operational_definition: Generic Canary closure hashes and validates all Canary Python files except the two unreachable standalone real-probe entrypoints, approves no third-party dependency, and rejects any included module that imports either excluded executable. Explicit PTR4 and PTR7 scopes include their own executable, exclude only the other probe executable, and validate their declared dependency set.
forbidden_narrowing: No temporary allowlist passed by the Fresh Short materializer
No runtime monkeypatch, import hook, exception suppression, or validation bypass
No broad httpx approval in the generic Canary scope
No unknown profile fallback to the generic or a permissive scope
No exclusion once an included module makes a probe entrypoint reachable
No production runtime, Prompt, Model, Route, Retry, Fallback, Budget, Validator, StoryState, Canon, READY, Draft, Final Review, or Maintenance behavior change
